text: Parse the complete stream so quoted records span physical lines.

arguments.patch:
diff --git a/mini_data_utils/csvlite.py b/mini_data_utils/csvlite.py
--- a/mini_data_utils/csvlite.py
+++ b/mini_data_utils/csvlite.py
@@ -1,13 +1,11 @@
 """A deliberately small CSV reader with one audited defect."""
 
 import csv
+import io
 
 
 def parse_rows(text: str) -> list[list[str]]:
     """Parse CSV text into rows while preserving quoted values."""
 
-    rows: list[list[str]] = []
-    for physical_line in text.splitlines():
-        rows.extend(csv.reader([physical_line]))
-    return rows
+    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text, newline="")))
